vikisozluk_etimolojiler.metin: Denominal verb of شَتْلَة (šatla), or also from Aramaic שׁתל / ܫܬܱܠ (štal, “to plant”).

Borrowed from Aramaic שִתלָא (šiṯlā) / ܫܷܬܠܴܐ (šeṯlā), ܫܷܬܷܠܬܴܐ (šeṯelṯā), ܫܬܷܠܬܴܐ (šəṯelṯā, “plant offshoot”), from Akkadian [script needed] (šitlum). Also from Semitic: Armenian շիթիլ (šitʻil), Turkish şitil, Azerbaijani şitil.
Noun of place from the root ش ت ل (š t l).
See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.

mana.dayanak_tanim: put or set (seeds, seedlings, or plants) into the ground
